description: Manual/subagent trigger-regression matrix for the CppStudio donor and lane-routing skills. Repo validation checks schema, tags, and path integrity; fresh agent behavior still requires a manual or delegated rerun.

cases.name: vulkan-default-greenfield
cases.prompt_shape: New realtime 3D or GPU C++ project where the user does not specify CUDA or Vulkan.
cases.expected_behavior: Recommend Vulkan first, proceed Vulkan-only by default, and avoid CUDA donor/runtime routing unless the user chooses CUDA or requirements force it.

cases.name: explicit-cuda-kernel
cases.prompt_shape: Custom CUDA C++ kernel, CUTLASS-like GEMM, FlashAttention-style attention, or CUDA graph work.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the CUDA lane and CUDA donor profiles first; Vulkan is optional only for explicit presentation or interop needs.

cases.name: explicit-cuda-vulkan-interop
cases.prompt_shape: CUDA produces data consumed by Vulkan, or Vulkan resources are shared with CUDA.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the mixed lane deliberately and keep build options, tests, and docs explicit about the CUDA/Vulkan boundary.

cases.name: vulkan-target-cuda-donor-reference
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan-first C++ Gaussian splatting, neural 3D, grooming, or simulation work where the strongest donor implementation is CUDA-heavy.
cases.expected_behavior: Stay in the Vulkan lane, use CUDA-heavy donors as algorithm/data-layout/test references, and do not add CUDA runtime, CUDA tests, or CUDA/Vulkan interop unless explicitly requested.

cases.name: cuda-target-non-cuda-donor-reference
cases.prompt_shape: CUDA C++ simulation or geometry kernel work that wants to reuse solver, layout, or validation ideas from Vulkan, OpenCL, DirectX, CPU, or DCC donors.
cases.expected_behavior: Stay in the CUDA lane, use non-CUDA donors as domain references, and translate implementation details through CUDA kernel-authoring guidance without adding Vulkan or other runtime dependencies.

cases.name: vulkan-memory-resource-lifetime
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan C++ renderer or compute app needs buffer/image allocation, memory budgets, mapped staging buffers, resource lifetime, or allocation pools.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to Vulkan foundation tooling before renderer samples; use VMA as the first allocation donor and keep Vulkan memory/lifetime policy separate from CUDA.

cases.name: vulkan-shader-reflection-toolchain
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan C++ project needs GLSL to SPIR-V compilation, SPIR-V validation, descriptor reflection, push constant reflection, shader cross-compilation, or Slang evaluation.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to Vulkan foundation tooling and SPIR-V/Slang profiles; keep compile, validation, reflection, and runtime pipeline creation as separate concerns.

cases.name: vulkan-gltf-runtime-viewer
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan-first C++ app loads GLB/glTF assets, uploads buffers/textures, previews PBR materials, or needs a runtime 3D asset viewer.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to glTF runtime assets plus Vulkan foundation tooling; keep CPU import, GPU upload, texture/material handling, and render pipeline policy separate.

cases.name: vulkan-renderer-architecture-donors
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan-first C++ renderer needs donor guidance for renderer backbone, render graph, PBR materials, frame architecture, or graphics middleware.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to graphics-rendering and renderer-backbone profiles; keep Vulkan foundation tooling available for API correctness without switching to CUDA or forcing a multi-backend dependency.

cases.name: webgpu-native-dawn-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ or native tooling task explicitly asks for WebGPU, webgpu.h, Dawn, WGSL, Tint, or WebGPU portability across Vulkan, D3D, Metal, and browser-adjacent targets.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to graphics-rendering and the Dawn profile; keep Vulkan-first policy intact unless the user explicitly chooses WebGPU as the implementation lane.

cases.name: browser-3d-webxr-donors
cases.prompt_shape: Browser 3D, WebGL/WebGPU, WebXR, controls, loaders, or interactive 3D viewer work needs donor references before translating behavior into native C++ or a web target.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to graphics-rendering and the three.js/Babylon.js profiles; treat browser engine behavior as a donor surface, not a reason to add CUDA or native Vulkan requirements.

cases.name: physical-path-tracing-donors
cases.prompt_shape: Renderer work needs physically based rendering, offline reference images, path tracing, sampling, material/light transport behavior, differentiable rendering, or inverse rendering references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to graphics-rendering and pbrt-v4/Mitsuba/THREE.js PathTracing Renderer profiles; use CUDA or OptiX paths only as references unless the target lane explicitly requires them.

cases.name: realtime-raytracing-framework-donors
cases.prompt_shape: Realtime rendering framework work needs render graphs, ray tracing, path tracing, RTX SDK boundaries, shader/model loading, or prototype renderer architecture references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to graphics-rendering and Falcor plus Vulkan sample profiles; keep NVIDIA SDK and vendor-specific dependencies explicit rather than silently adding them to a portable Vulkan target.

cases.name: cpu-visualization-rendering-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ visualization tool needs CPU rendering, scientific visualization renderer architecture, volume renderer APIs, RenderKit, OSPRay, or a CPU reference path for GPU output.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to geometry-simulation and OSPRay/Embree profiles; use CPU visualization as reference or dependency surface without disabling Vulkan or CUDA validation for the selected target lane.

cases.name: engine-architecture-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ 3D tool or engine work needs engine/editor architecture, scene trees, component systems, asset processor design, editor/runtime split, or large-scale rendering/physics integration references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to project archetypes, geometry-simulation, and Godot/O3DE profiles; treat engine-scale donors as architecture references unless the project explicitly adopts an engine.

cases.name: dcc-editorial-pipeline-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ DCC pipeline or virtual-production tool needs scene interchange, USD/Alembic caches, MaterialX look data, editorial timelines, OTIO, review handoff, or Blender workflow references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to dcc-scene-pipeline and the matching OpenUSD, Alembic, MaterialX, OpenTimelineIO, OpenSubdiv, or Blender study-only profile; keep DCC plugins and assets license-separated.

cases.name: volume-voxel-rendering-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ or GPU volume tool needs sparse VDB/NanoVDB IO, voxel grids, GPU volume traversal, fVDB sparse-volume ML, VTK scientific visualization, or volume-rendering references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to volumes-voxels and the OpenVDB/NanoVDB, fVDB, and VTK profiles; keep volume IO, ML tensors, renderer upload, and visualization toolkit choices separate.

cases.name: material-texture-color-pipeline-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ asset or renderer pipeline needs KTX/KTX2, Basis transcoding, EXR/HDR image IO, TinyEXR, OpenImageIO, OpenColorIO, color management, ACES/OCIO, or MaterialX references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to texture-material-color and the matching KTX/Basis, OpenColorIO/OpenImageIO, TinyEXR, or MaterialX profile; keep assets, configs, textures, and color data license-separated.

cases.name: cad-precision-geometry-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ CAD or precision geometry tool needs B-reps, NURBS, STEP/IGES, exact geometry, tessellation, Booleans, CGAL, Open CASCADE, or FreeCAD workflow references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to cad-precision-geometry and the Open CASCADE, CGAL, libigl, or FreeCAD study-only profile; keep CAD kernel data, render meshes, tolerances, and license boundaries explicit.

cases.name: geometry-processing-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ geometry-processing task needs subdivision surfaces, remeshing, deformation, parameterization, robust triangulation, exact predicates, mesh repair, libigl, CGAL, OpenSubdiv, or meshoptimizer references.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to surfaces-subdivision and the matching OpenSubdiv, libigl, CGAL, or meshoptimizer profile; keep robust geometry and runtime mesh conditioning as separate choices.

cases.name: xr-openxr-runtime-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ XR app needs OpenXR loader/runtime guidance, OpenXR-Hpp C++ bindings, Monado runtime diagnostics, vendor-specific OpenXR extensions, Godot OpenXR Vendors, stereo swapchains, actions, or frame timing.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to xr-spatial, graphics-rendering, OpenXR SDK, OpenXR-Hpp, Monado, and Godot OpenXR Vendors profiles; keep portable OpenXR baseline separate from vendor-specific extensions.

cases.name: ambiguous-3d-viewer-lookup-routing
cases.prompt_shape: C++ 3D viewer or realtime asset preview tool needs donors, but the prompt does not yet specify whether the hard part is Vulkan setup, renderer architecture, glTF import, mesh conditioning, textures, CAD, or XR.
cases.expected_behavior: Open agent-lookup first, then narrow to the smallest category set; prefer Vulkan-first implementation unless requirements force CUDA or another backend.

cases.name: ambiguous-gpu-simulation-lookup-routing
cases.prompt_shape: GPU simulation request mentions particles, cloth, physics, CUDA, Vulkan, and visualization without saying whether the main need is solver donors, CUDA kernels, Vulkan rendering, or physics SDK selection.
cases.expected_behavior: Open agent-lookup first, then route solver/reference donors through simulation-gpu while keeping CUDA kernels and Vulkan visualization as separate lane-specific choices.

cases.name: asset-pipeline-lookup-routing
cases.prompt_shape: C++ asset pipeline or viewer request mentions USD, glTF, textures, materials, mesh optimization, importer fixtures, and renderer upload in one broad prompt.
cases.expected_behavior: Open agent-lookup first, then split DCC interchange, glTF runtime loading, texture/material/color, and mesh conditioning instead of treating the whole request as one dependency.

cases.name: scientific-volume-viewer-lookup-routing
cases.prompt_shape: Scientific C++ volume viewer request mentions VTK data, VDB/NanoVDB volumes, Vulkan visualization, and optional sparse-volume ML references.
cases.expected_behavior: Open agent-lookup first, then route volume data through volumes-voxels, visualization through Vulkan/graphics only when rendering is in scope, and ML sparse tensors through fVDB only when needed.

cases.name: ai-runtime-visualization-lookup-routing
cases.prompt_shape: C++ tool combines local model inference or AI runtime output with Vulkan visualization, 3D viewer UX, or neural 3D assets.
cases.expected_behavior: Open agent-lookup first, then keep AI runtime, neural 3D, renderer, and Vulkan synchronization decisions separate instead of routing everything through CUDA kernel donors.

cases.name: gltf-meshoptimizer-runtime-pipeline
cases.prompt_shape: C++ runtime asset pipeline loads glTF/GLB, validates fixtures, optimizes vertex/index buffers, handles meshopt compression, and uploads renderer-ready buffers.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to glTF runtime assets first, then geometry-simulation and meshoptimizer for mesh conditioning; keep CPU import, optimization, and GPU upload as separate stages.

cases.name: assimp-vulkan-asset-import
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan C++ viewer needs to import several non-glTF 3D asset formats, normalize meshes/materials, and hand them to a Vulkan renderer.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to geometry-simulation and assimp for broad import, then graphics/Vulkan guidance for renderer handoff; do not treat assimp as a reason to abandon Vulkan-first implementation.

cases.name: bvh-geometry-acceleration
cases.prompt_shape: C++ renderer or geometry tool needs BVH, ray queries, CPU reference intersections, Embree comparison, or lightweight acceleration structures.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to geometry-simulation and BVH/Embree profiles; use CPU donors as reference or dependency candidates without forcing Vulkan ray tracing or CUDA kernels unless requested.

cases.name: physics-collision-donor-selection
cases.prompt_shape: C++ realtime 3D app needs rigid-body physics, collision queries, broadphase/narrowphase, constraints, or debug-render handoff.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to geometry-simulation and Jolt/Bullet profiles; keep physics dependency choice separate from Vulkan renderer and CUDA kernel lanes.

cases.name: local-llm-runtime-donors
cases.prompt_shape: C++ app needs local LLM inference, GGUF model loading, quantization, tokenizer/model conversion, or a small OpenAI-compatible local server.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to AI runtime donors and llama.cpp/ggml first; keep model weights, tokenizer files, and backend selection separate from reusable C++ infrastructure.

cases.name: production-llm-serving-donors
cases.prompt_shape: Production LLM serving with batching, paged KV cache, OpenAI-compatible APIs, TensorRT engines, vLLM comparison, or NVIDIA GPU deployment.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to TensorRT-LLM and vLLM profiles; keep TensorRT-LLM CUDA/NVIDIA-specific and do not imply portability when the user needs cross-platform inference.

cases.name: portable-inference-compiler-runtime
cases.prompt_shape: C++ model runtime needs ONNX execution providers, portable model inference, compiled LLM deployment, TVM code generation, Vulkan/WebGPU/mobile targets, or runtime artifact packaging.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to ONNX Runtime, MLC-LLM, and TVM profiles; keep compiler/runtime artifacts and target backend validation separate from model source assets.

cases.name: tiny-cuda-nn-neural-kernels
cases.prompt_shape: CUDA C++ neural graphics kernel needs fused MLPs, multiresolution hash grids, compact encodings, tiny neural network kernels, or instant-ngp-style CUDA components.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to CUDA lane plus tiny-cuda-nn; use study-only instant-ngp only for concepts and do not add it as reusable source.

cases.name: neural-3d-workflow-donors
cases.prompt_shape: Neural 3D or Gaussian splatting workflow needs training/data processing, camera conventions, differentiable 3D ops, point-cloud reconstruction, viewer/export flows, or PyTorch reference outputs.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to neural-3d and the relevant Nerfstudio, gsplat, Kaolin, PyTorch3D, Open3D, and PyTorch profiles while keeping datasets and weights license-separated.

cases.name: vulkan-neural-3d-cuda-donor-reference
cases.prompt_shape: Vulkan-first neural 3D viewer or Gaussian splatting runtime wants to use gsplat, tiny-cuda-nn, PyTorch3D, or CUDA-heavy papers as references without adding CUDA.
cases.expected_behavior: Stay Vulkan-first, use CUDA-heavy neural donors for algorithms/layouts/tests, and do not add CUDA runtime, CUDA tests, or interop unless explicitly requested.

cases.name: neural-graphics-study-only-routing
cases.prompt_shape: Task asks about original GraphDeco Gaussian Splatting, instant-ngp, Kaolin Wisp, non-commercial neural graphics references, or paper behavior checks.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to the study-only neural graphics profile and keep restricted sources as concepts/behavior checks only; prefer permissive donors for implementation patterns.

cases.name: generic-ai-assistant-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Build an AI assistant UI, prompt helper, chatbot workflow, or SaaS app with no C++, GPU, local model runtime, CUDA, Vulkan, ML compiler, or neural 3D scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to CppStudio AI-runtime donors just because the product uses AI.

cases.name: generic-web-ui-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Build a normal web dashboard, landing page, form, or frontend UI with no 3D scene, WebGPU, WebGL, WebXR, renderer, native C++, CUDA, Vulkan, or GPU runtime scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to browser 3D, WebGPU, renderer, or CppStudio donor guidance for ordinary frontend work.

cases.name: game-story-design-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Brainstorm game story, level theme, character descriptions, UI copy, or design notes with no implementation, engine architecture, C++, Vulkan, CUDA, renderer, asset pipeline, or 3D runtime request.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to Godot, O3DE, renderer, or donor-library guidance for non-implementation game-design writing.

cases.name: generic-video-editing-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Edit, trim, caption, transcode, or export an ordinary video timeline with no C++, DCC interchange, OpenTimelineIO, media pipeline architecture, virtual production, or coding-agent donor request.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to DCC or OpenTimelineIO donors for ordinary video editing instructions.

cases.name: ordinary-image-upload-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Add ordinary image upload, thumbnail resize, PNG/JPEG preview, CSS color picker, or web form image handling with no C++, renderer, GPU texture pipeline, EXR/HDR, OCIO, KTX, or MaterialX scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to texture/material/color donors for ordinary web or app image handling.

cases.name: cad-ui-mockup-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Design a CAD-looking dashboard, landing page, icon, or UI mockup with no CAD kernel, B-rep, NURBS, STEP/IGES, exact geometry, tessellation, C++, Vulkan, or implementation scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to CAD, CGAL, Open CASCADE, libigl, or FreeCAD donor guidance for visual mockups.

cases.name: vr-storyboarding-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Brainstorm VR game story, headset marketing copy, immersive scene concept art, or non-implementation spatial experience ideas with no OpenXR, C++, Vulkan, runtime, device, swapchain, or extension work.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to XR/OpenXR donor guidance for non-implementation ideation.

cases.name: python-ml-script-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Ordinary Python scikit-learn, pandas, notebook, or training script work with no C++ extension, GPU kernel, model runtime integration, CUDA, Vulkan, or 3D scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not trigger CppStudio donor routing for ordinary Python ML work.

cases.name: generic-render-text-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Render a markdown document, text template, HTML string, or report with no C++, GPU, graphics API, 3D scene, mesh, renderer, or realtime visualization scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to graphics-rendering donors just because the word render appears.

cases.name: generic-import-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Import CSV, JSON, contacts, invoices, or business records with no C++, 3D asset, mesh, renderer, Vulkan, CUDA, glTF, or DCC scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to assimp, glTF, meshoptimizer, or geometry-simulation donors for ordinary data import work.

cases.name: generic-json-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Generic JSON parser, schema validation, or business-data import task with no C++, GPU, Vulkan, rendering, 3D asset, glTF, or runtime viewer scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to glTF runtime asset donors just because glTF uses JSON internally.

cases.name: generic-shader-text-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Generic text templating, syntax highlighting, or non-GPU shader-like string processing without Vulkan, SPIR-V, GLSL, HLSL, Slang, or graphics runtime scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not route to Vulkan shader tooling donors unless the task names Vulkan, SPIR-V, shader compilation, reflection, or a graphics/compute runtime.

cases.name: python-negative-control
cases.prompt_shape: Python CLI, virtualenv, parser, or business simulation with no C++, GPU, rendering, CUDA, Vulkan, 3D, physics, or AI-runtime scope.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not trigger CppStudio donor-library routing.
